problem: Compliance deployment is blocked because completed batch results are not signed by the cryptographic module required for this regulated environment, so the compliance operator cannot release them.
outcome: The compliance operator can release each completed batch result because it is signed by the required FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic module.
acceptance: A completed batch result carries a signature produced by the required FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic module
The compliance operator can validate that signature before release
non_goals: Changing who may release a batch
constraints: The published agency security profile ASP-12 requires batch-result signatures to use a FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic module.
